decisions.reason: Locates patch.yml's rename patch on SessionView.ts, the cordis.patch.yml composition that references it as a patch entry, apply-patch.mjs and the package.json script wiring, and explains the coupling to stable upstream symbols in the split session-view source.

Locates the emit/subscribe pair with ignorable:true at index.ts:13-22 and correctly applies corridor folding: alpha.1 removed the marker, alpha.2 restored the retention contract, so the legacy informational producer is judged against the restored final state; no whitelist or Session.append claim is made.

Locates ctx.get('apiProxy') with session.rename and llm.providers invokes at index.ts:25-32, but only says to migrate to a generic 'public service/Remote surface' without distinguishing host-plane domain-service injection (e.g. ctx.llm.listProviders) from the browser-plane ctx.remote, and misses the llm.providers split into two calls.

Locates the hardcoded homedir()/.dsh/profiles/default write at index.ts:35-38, but the remedy ('use the provided profile/path APIs') never names runtime DSH_HOME or the target profile as source of truth; it correctly does not claim --profile was introduced in alpha.1.

Locates both the private @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-view/internal import (index.ts:9-10) and the registerCommand constructing SessionView (index.ts:41-43), but only gestures at 'public contribution API' without explaining owner/seam verification against the target tag or marking unverified seams pending.

Locates the loopback 127.0.0.1:43121 /api/legacy server at index.ts:45-54, treats the unauthenticated private route as a hole rather than an accepted bypass, and prescribes routing through the Host Gateway's authenticated channel instead of a raw route.

Locates both dsh subprocess call sites and their per-line JSON.parse of stdout (index.ts:56-67, apply-patch.mjs:11-18) and the right fix (parse final plain text), but frames it as a stdout contract change in the corridor when rc.2 stdout was already the final text (the JSONL assumption was already wrong) and never mentions the stderr reasoning segment.

Only #4->A1-04 and #2->A1-02 (folding discussion matches A2-01 but never names it) are correct; #1/#3/#5/#6/#7 are mis-mapped by an invented 'A1-0N equals category #N' rule, including nonexistent A1-06/A1-07, so the bulk of the mapping is wrong despite grounded touchpoint analysis.

Correctly reports all seven categories hit (so no no-hit categories), lists every fixture file scanned, explains why no-hit would not prove no problem, and notes the card document's absence as a limit; but it proposes no verification follow-up (target-version build/typecheck, isolated boot, functional path).
